metas.name: Annihilation
metas.description: Directed by Alex Garland (Ex Machina), this film blends complex science fiction with psychological horror, perfectly matching your appreciation for cerebral, tense thrillers.

metas.name: Prisoners
metas.description: From Denis Villeneuve (director of Sicario), this dark, high-stakes mystery features a grueling, intense search for missing children that matches the gritty tone of Zodiac.

metas.name: The Invitation
metas.description: A high-tension chamber thriller set at a dinner party. It slowly builds paranoia and dread in a way that fans of Exam and Conclave will appreciate.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: An atmospheric, low-budget science fiction thriller that focuses on character dialogue and mounting psychological tension, appealing to fans of The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A dark, gritty, and morally complex look into the world of L.A. crime journalism, matching the psychological intrigue of Gone Girl.

metas.name: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
metas.description: An intense, deeply unsettling psychological thriller with dark humor, matching the cold, calculated tension of Ex Machina and the psychological weight of The Master.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: An atmospheric, prestige horror film that favors historical accuracy and dread over jump scares, matching the gothic, tense vibe of The Others.

metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: A brilliant, high-concept science fiction drama with immense emotional stakes, appealing to your love for intellectually challenging cinema like Ex Machina.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: A masterclass in psychological tension and atmospheric mystery, making it a perfect follow-up to Zodiac and Gone Girl.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: A relentless, gritty neo-western crime thriller with exceptional tension and high stakes, matching the brutal efficiency of Sicario.

metas.name: There Will Be Blood
metas.description: A sweeping, intense drama about obsession and power starring Daniel Day-Lewis. Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, who also directed The Master.

metas.name: Se7en
metas.description: David Fincher's quintessential crime thriller. It features a dark, rainy atmosphere and a twisting mystery that aligns perfectly with Zodiac.

metas.name: The Menu
metas.description: A sharp, satirical dark comedy thriller with high stakes, perfect for fans of In Bruges and the witty, intense nature of It's What's Inside.

metas.name: Upgrade
metas.description: A slick, intensely paced science fiction thriller with dark undertones and incredible action choreography, appealing to fans of Ex Machina.

metas.name: 10 Cloverfield Lane
metas.description: An incredibly tense, claustrophobic thriller with a powerhouse performance by John Goodman, aligning with the mystery and stakes of Exam.

metas.name: Identity
metas.description: A psychological mystery thriller set in a single, isolated location, echoing the structure and suspense found in Exam and The Others.

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description: A psychological horror film of prestige quality, focusing on two lighthouse keepers descending into madness, capturing the intensity of The Master.

metas.name: The Game
metas.description: A classic David Fincher mystery thriller that keeps you guessing at every turn, sharing DNA with Gone Girl and Exam.

metas.name: Parasite
metas.description: An award-winning thriller and dark comedy that shifts gears masterfully, offering the sharp writing and intense stakes you enjoy.

metas.name: Wind River
metas.description: A gripping murder mystery set in a harsh Wyoming winter, written by the screenwriter of Sicario, sharing its gritty, solemn tone.

metas.name: A Quiet Place
metas.description: An intense, high-concept horror thriller where silence is survival, matching the atmospheric dread of 28 Days Later.

metas.name: Midsommar
metas.description: A disturbing, brightly-lit folk horror film that targets emotional trauma and psychology, perfect for fans of Smile 2.

metas.name: It Follows
metas.description: An indie horror sensation that uses atmosphere, dread, and a brilliant synth soundtrack to create relentless, slow-burn tension.

metas.name: Predestination
metas.description: A mind-bending science fiction mystery that demands your full attention, much like The Artifice Girl and The Man from Earth.

metas.name: Primer
metas.description: An ultra-realistic, highly complex sci-fi thriller that avoids hand-holding, appealing to the analytical nature of Exam.

metas.name: A Serious Man
metas.description: A darkly comic, existential drama from the Coen Brothers that matches the intellectual weight of My Dinner with Andre and the humor of In Bruges.

metas.name: Zero Dark Thirty
metas.description: A relentless, high-stakes political and military thriller directed by Kathryn Bigelow, perfect for fans of The Hurt Locker and Sicario.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description: An emotionally devastating mystery drama with massive stakes and an unforgettable twist, directed by Denis Villeneuve.

metas.name: The Gift
metas.description: A quiet, deeply uncomfortable psychological thriller about past secrets coming back to haunt a couple, matching the tension of Gone Girl.

metas.name: The Babadook
metas.description: An acclaimed psychological horror film that uses grief as a monster, offering emotional complexity similar to The Others.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description: A melancholic dark comedy-drama from the director of In Bruges, reuniting Colin Farrell and Brendan Gleeson for a brilliant character study.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description: A psychological thriller masterpiece in animation that deeply explores identity and reality, matching the intensity of Gone Girl.

metas.name: Black Swan
metas.description: A psychological thriller focusing on artistic obsession and a descent into madness, mirroring the raw intensity of Smile 2 and The Master.

metas.name: The Double
metas.description: A stylized, dystopian dark comedy thriller based on Dostoevsky's novella, offering the quirky tension found in It's What's Inside.

metas.name: Blue Ruin
metas.description: A raw, gritty revenge thriller about an amateur assassin, presenting high tension and realistic stakes reminiscent of Gran Torino and Sicario.

metas.name: Cure
metas.description: A slow-burn, deeply disturbing Japanese psychological thriller about a detective investigating bizarre murders, aligning with Zodiac.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description: A masterpiece of dystopian cinema, featuring incredible high-stakes tension, grit, and emotional weight matching 28 Days Later.

metas.name: Moon
metas.description: A lonely, intellectual science fiction drama with a central mystery that will appeal to fans of Ex Machina and The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: Faults
metas.description: An overlooked psychological thriller focusing on a cult deprogrammer and a young woman, matching the intimate mind games of Exam.

metas.name: Apostle
metas.description: A gritty, violent, and atmospheric period horror-thriller about a cult on a remote island, appealing to fans of The Conjuring 2.
